mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(input_tokens), 0) as input_tokens, coalesce(sum(output_tokens), 0) as output_tokens, coalesce(sum(cached_input_tokens), 0) as cached_input_tokens, coalesce(sum(input_tokens + output_tokens), 0) as total_tokens from codex_response_logs where created_at >= #{startTime} and created_at < #{endTime}
